applicant.name: Dr. Marie Dubois
applicant.organisation: Austrian social health insurance fund, disease management programmes

request.purpose: We evaluate whether our prevention programme reduced hospital admissions, to decide whether to extend it to all regions.
request.question: How many patients with hypertension have a systolic blood pressure of 140 or more, by age band?
definitions: Hypertension = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with I10.
Use the latest systolic blood pressure (LOINC 8480-6) per patient.
Uncontrolled hypertension = latest systolic blood pressure of 140 or higher.
Report per age band: patients with hypertension who have a systolic value, % with uncontrolled hypertension, one decimal.
